claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b086] Scope decisions for this batch (lines 1-172 of results/ci-metadata-registry.md; sibling batches cover lines 173-214 and 215-343). Out of C4 scope per instrument rule 5 and therefore not extracted: all dates and timestamps (the `Generated:` line, every `date_generated` cell, "Archived 2026-04-23", "verified on 2026-04-20"), the git commit hash `b57cf6c2`, session numbers inside `archive/planning-completed-session-81-82/ci-rerun-todo.md`, schema/version strings, and numbers that sit inside file paths or condition names (`55maps`, `384px`/`512px`, the `20m`/`30m`/`40m`/`50m` directory labels, `h8-v2`, `h12-v2`, `phase2a`-`phase3c`, `t0`/`t4`, `02-canonical-last`, `26-high-25of30`, `hp4hn4`, `pro_2x2_matrix`, `k5_replicate_sweep`, `020_vs_160`, `pool_160`, `single-pass-384-UNINTENDED-T1.0`). Two registry rows yield no claims because every digit in them sits inside a file name: line 131 (verifier_summary.json, NO-CI) and line 157 (the H10 NO-CI row). Anchoring policy: the iterations and seed columns anchor to the artefact the row itself names -- the co-located sidecar ($.bootstrap.n_iterations, $.bootstrap.seed) for YES_SIDECAR rows, the in-file key quoted in the notes cell for YES rows, and the generating script's constant or argparse default where the row asserts a script default (non-JSON anchors are legitimate per the v1.1 calibration note and route to triage). ci_count cells written as products ("3 metrics x 4 buffers") are split into their component counts; the product total takes recompute-script unless a sidecar records `ci_count` or `coverage_file_count`. File-class counts ("(7 files)", "~80 files") take recompute-script against the glob unless a directory-level sidecar records the count. Four rows name paths that are no longer in the working tree (the h11 UNINTENDED analysis_report, the two e47-v1-vs-v2 sweeps and the e47 grid/detect-single-pass classes, and results/h10/statistical_analysis.json plus results/h10/wbf/variant_c_vs_greedy_hp4hn4.json); each is anchored to its archive location and the relocation is named in that claim's notes. Approximation markers (~, >=) are kept inside value_verbatim per v1.2 amendment 5. Correction phrases ("corrected from 6 to 5", "from ~80 to 43", "from ~30 to 18", and the stale 16-file row) record the superseded figure as `historical` and the current figure as a live claim per rule 3. The two document-structural counts extracted at lines 8-11 and 14 ("four paper-reproducibility fields", "Four completeness states") are included under the include-when-in-doubt rule but are self-referential to this document's own schema and are the most prunable claims in the batch.
